pairs.subject: invariant-placement
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/researchView.ts:28 A research card whose kind is outside the known set is quietly turned into a 'fact' in the emitted view, so the invalid kind becomes a valid one and no observable records that the coercion happened.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/researchView.ts:28 Repairs instead of refusing: an unknown card kind is coerced to 'fact' with no count, log or flag, so every downstream assertion over legal kinds passes.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/realScene.ts:58 A missing job.enqueued time is emitted as the epoch (1970-01-01), a made-up value in the PartView sent to the editor. The same line omits an absent `stage`, which is the posture the technique asks for.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/realRecs.ts:14 The record shape is checked only at the kernel's write door. The read side is a bare cast, and its comment depends on the writers, so a corrupted record cannot be traced to either side.
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/schema.ts:16 Every op enters through one strict zod door: an extra field is refused, not silently dropped (door altitude, chosen explicitly).

tests/next-server/parts-real.test.ts:113 A negative test checks that the op-kind door refuses an op meant for another editor kind. The voice-fx-ask door (schema.ts:105) has its own refusal sweep in producer-step-voice-fx.test.ts:161.
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/kinds.ts:41 A cross-table invariant (every editor kind has a working-record line) is checked by the type checker in every configuration, not by a selected branch.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/kinds.ts:167 The receipt's binding to its target is a digest of the parts, recomputed on each confirm, never declared, so a receipt for plate A cannot confirm a render of B.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/real.ts:123 An unbound kind is a Partial lookup returning undefined plus an explicit refusal, not a 'none' member added to EditorKind. Non-editor tabs carry verdict null, not a fake state.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/real.ts:56 Store operations need a Store value that only the Result-returning opener yields, so a failed open is a value the caller has to branch on, not a null check someone must remember.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/contract.ts:20 The two same-typed ids cross the port as named fields, which TypeScript checks structurally. port.ts:36 flattens them into positional (projectId, key) arguments, but there a swap fails loudly as not-found, not as empty success.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/real.ts:141 The one-shot act token crosses a server-action (network) boundary and is held to one purchase by a store-side dedupe. That is delivery-guarantee territory, which this technique excludes.

pairs.subject: invariant-placement
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/library/_port/present.ts:52 A cover with an unknown mime is emitted as ?type=image/jpeg even though blobRoute (lib/library/media.ts:9) accepts mime null and serves an untyped URL. The presenter invents a value the store left unknown, and every tile consumer trusts it.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/library/_port/present.ts:52 An optional part (cover.mime: string | null) is given a default at the emission mapping instead of being left out, which the technique names as the failure.
app/(studio)/library/_port/real.ts:178 The kernel's silent 'nothing changed' is turned into a refusal instead of being absorbed. A stale toggle is reported, not quietly agreed with.
tests/next-server/library-real.test.ts:105 A negative test checks that the second pin is refused, so removing the refusal would turn the suite red.

app/(studio)/library/_port/actions.ts:31 Acts enter through one zod discriminated-union door in the action core. Unlike the part schema these objects are not .strict(), so extra fields are dropped, not refused.
app/(studio)/library/_port/present.ts:128 The detail's pinned state is derived from the acts the index offers, not stored as a separate flag that could drift.
app/(studio)/library/_port/present.ts:80 The resolver returns an optional kind; it filters out the 'all' key and does not add a placeholder member to LibraryKindName.
app/(studio)/library/_port/real.ts:122 Each verb must first get a Store from a Result and returns the open failure unchanged, so it cannot touch the store unopened.
app/(studio)/library/_port/real.ts:49 The side's verbs take one string id plus parameters of distinct types. No pair of same-typed members can be swapped.

pairs.registryProposal: completeness-at-emission could name the presentation mapper (domain row -> screen card) as an emission boundary. That is where defaults like a mime fallback or an epoch timestamp tend to show up, because the presenter's goal is to never draw an empty tile.
